subject: Action needed: expired Coupa invite preventing PO processing (Oxigene)

From: Sabrina Lopez <s.lopez@oxigene.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: portal-admin@oxigene.com
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cannot accept supplier portal invite (link expired)

Hi Neha,

We received the Coupa invite this morning but when I click the link I get an error that the invite has expired. Our procurement and AP team are blocked — we have two POs in your system pending acceptance (PO# 2026-0894, 2026-0895). The portal shows no way for me to request a new invite.

Can you resend the invite or provide a direct registration link? Also let me know whether we need to provide additional tax/bank documents before the vendor record is fully activated. I attached a screenshot of the error.

Thanks,
Sabrina Lopez
Head of Procurement
Oxigene Corp

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cannot accept supplier portal invite (link expired)

Hi Sabrina — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the friction. I confirmed the invite link generated by Coupa expired (our admin policy issues links that expire after 7 days).

Immediate plan:
- I will ask our Coupa admin to resend a fresh invite to the same address (you should see a new email within ~15 minutes).
- To fully activate the vendor record and allow PO routing we require: legal entity name, W-9 (US) / W-8 (non-US), and bank details (via our secure upload).
- If the supplier record remains incomplete after you accept the invite, Finance will not route POs to payment. I copied Laura (Finance Ops) to confirm whether we can temporarily manual-route the two pending POs.

Next steps for you: accept the new invite, then upload the tax form and bank details in the portal. I attached our vendor-onboarding checklist that shows the fields Coupa will ask for. If you run into the link-expired error again, reply here and we can provide a one-time registration token.

Links: vendor onboarding playbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/vendor-onboarding-playbook

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
